name: -------- PCC Rebuilt [1.21.10 - 26.3] -------- Creative Minigames Oneblock AND Racing
description:
Pocket Creative Club is back! Now branded as PCC Rebuilt (or PCCR), this is a new server dedicated to the Minecraft crossplay experience. Our server costs absolutely nothing to play, and with an excellent community to interact with, is the place to build and have fun. This is an English server, if you are not fluent in English, you may try your best, otherwise, you may need to use a translator or a friend

We offer:

- Java/Bedrock Crossplay

- Support for most game versions

- Support for many client-side QoL mods, such as Axiom, Freecam and Litematica.

- A semi-active community

- Features such as HeadDB and ImageFrame for custom image maps

- Zero ranks or other micro-transaction paid features

- A work-in-progress server economy system

- Oneblock Survival

- Survival 

- Ice Boat Racing and other minigames!

We now offer creative and survival!

Survival consists of an infinite survival world, so you can build what you want! Please note that the survival world is not intended for beating the game or for progression. It is solely a way to build with Survival limitations.

The creative world is plot-based and fully vanilla apart from some QoL features. We offer two 500x500 plots, with an opportunity to purchase two extra with 5 million server points/plot and level 12 on the Discord, and WorldEdit.

For more details, join the Discord.

PCCR is an approved reboot of the original PCC server that was owned by PhanaticD.

Our promise is to be a community server managed and supported by the community.

For the Java port: https://minecraft-mp.com/server-s344306
